Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 30

“Renouncing all actions in me, with your mind on the self, free of longing and possessiveness, fight — your fever gone.”

A whole practice compressed into one line, and the last word is remarkable: vigata-jvara, fever gone. Krishna wants the action performed without the heat Arjuna has been running.
